summary: [spec fidelity] a rule or domain whose code is the command's own is still enforced in the handler after the repository, plan sources and files are read, so spec 11.7 (steps 1-6 give the same answer whatever the state) and 10.8.3 (validators come after domains and constraints) do not hold for it: in an empty directory `finding close --disposition rejected` (no --reason), `finding close --round 0`, `divergence add --state deferred`, `evidence add --command-result x`, `evidence audit --report-case x`, `evidence approval-payload` without --task/--scenario answer CONFIG_MISSING; with a repository `evidence add --command-result x --signature-file nosuch` answers the missing file and `--task T --report-case x` answers PLAN_SOURCES_MISSING instead of the declared rule; and `evidence add --all-scenarios --scenario S --artifact bare.png` answers the `--artifact` validator before the declared `forbids`; exit code is always 2 and nothing is written, so the harm is the wrong code/field for a call with two faults; blast radius: the sweeps run each rule on a story repo with every file present, so they never see this order
